Description.DefaultText: Open the level-up screen for an existing character and edit their build: lower skills, talents, spells and attributes, then re-spend the points. Use 'runscript respec1'. Originally inspired by Peter 'weriK' Kovacs (Character Respecialization, Nexus mod 14).
Description.en-us:
Opens the level-up screen for the current character, pre-filled with their existing build, so skills, talents, spells and attributes can be edited without rebuilding from scratch.
Open the console and type: runscript respec1
This mod does not perform a respecialisation. Once the screen is open, the existing build is directly editable.
The level-up indicator on the portrait is left exactly as vanilla: the engine only lets it open the screen when the character still has a point to spend, and no UI-side message can create the level-up session the screen needs.
Originally inspired by Peter 'weriK' Kovacs' "Character Respecialization" (Nexus mod 14).
